title: Shapes All Around
short: Find circles, triangles and rectangles in real things.

blocks.html: Shapes are everywhere! A clock is like a circle. A door is like a rectangle. A slice of pizza is like a triangle.

blocks.name: pk-pic
blocks.cap: A clock, a door and a slice of pizza. What shape is each one like?

blocks.html: Real things can look like shapes we know.

For the grown-up: Go on a shape walk inside or outside. Name the shapes you see: round wheels, rectangle doors, triangle roofs. Take turns finding one. Stop while it is still fun. Then go and play the real-life version.

items: Try it at home: Go on a shape walk.
Spot shapes in a picture book.
Make a shape picture from cut paper.
